title: Toyota 2000GT vs Datsun 240Z: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two Japanese six-cylinder sports cars arrived within two years of each other. One was a hand-built Toyota that cost more than a Porsche. The other was a Datsun that cost little more than half a Jaguar. This is the Toyota 2000GT against the Datsun 240Z, and the differences nobody explains clearly. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on the Toyota 2000GT, the Nissan S30 and the Nissan Z, Shannons Club, Hagerty, Classic and Sports Car, and Sports Car Market. They disagree in places, and some numbers we wanted are simply not in them, such as the 240Z's launch price. We show those gaps. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
